m2 <- readMM(gzfile('subtype.inflammation.q1.2.mtx.gz'))
cat(dim(m1), dim(m2), '\\n')

cat('gene sums nonzero counts:\\n')
gs1 <- Matrix::rowSums(m1); gs2 <- Matrix::rowSums(m2)
cat('median genes/cell? no\\n')
# top genes by total counts
top <- head(sort(gs1+gs2, decreasing=TRUE), 20)
print(data.frame(gene=genes"'$gene_symbols[as.integer(names(top))], total=top))
EOF
